events.title: Demo Update: Fixes and a New Night Atmosphere
events.summary: Hey, night-shift workers!During the demo's first week I watched your streams and read your reviews and messages. Thank you for all of them. Most of the fixes in this update come from your reports, along with a few improvements and a new touch to the nights.NewThe station is darker and the fog is thicker. events.title: Cursed Gas Station Demo is Out Now!
events.summary: Your first nights on the job It's the 1990s. You are Cole, the new night-shift worker at an isolated gas station. The demo covers his arrival and his first two shifts. Work the register, fuel the cars, restock the shelves, and deal with whoever pulls in off the road.As the nights go on, the routine starts to break. A conversation turns into an argument, and small details start to feel wrong.Steam Next Fest The demo will stay playable throughout Steam Next Fest, October 19–26.Wishlist Cursed Gas
